problems.reason: Both sentences state that analyses concluded Emiliasaura is outside the Rhabdodontomorpha clade (i.e., a styracosternan).

Sentences 6 and 7 present conflicting phylogenetic placements for Emiliasaura—one says it is outside Rhabdodontomorpha as a styracosternan, while others recover it as the most basal member of Rhabdodontomorpha.
Sentence 7 repeats the claim that Emiliasaura is the most basal member of the Rhabdodontomorpha twice (first and third analyses), making the statement redundant.
